description: Submit a service to the BotFriendly directory. There is no review queue: each interface URL must be on the service's own domain, or linked from the service's own site, and is fetched during the call; the listing publishes immediately if its MCP server, OpenAPI spec or API completes a handshake — one of has_mcp_server, has_openapi_spec or has_api is required; llms.txt, skill files and feeds only add badges. The url must be the product, not an article (/blog/, /news/ and similar are rejected), and a domain can add at most 2 listings a day and 3 in total. Every listing needs an icon — pass icon_url, or leave it out and the service's own site is checked for one.

api_url.description: Required when has_api is true: the API's base URL (api.example.com, or a path under /api or /v1). It must answer in JSON. On the service's own domain, or linked from its site.

icon_base64.description: Alternative to icon_url: the image inline, as a data: URI or bare base64.

icon_url.description: Link to the service's icon (PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP, under 1MB). Fetched and re-hosted, downscaled to 512px. Omit it and the service's site is checked for one.

mcp_server_url.description: Required when has_mcp_server is true. On the service's own domain, or linked from its site.

openapi_spec_url.description: Required when has_openapi_spec is true. On the service's own domain, or linked from its site.

name: submit_service
